doc.title: Lew Soloff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000

title: Closing and upcoming record Rainbow Mountain
summary: Thanks, and mention of an upcoming funk-fusion record, Rainbow Mountain.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well it’s been a great pleasure talking to you today.
My pleasure to talk to you.
And best of luck in your future projects. It’ll be interesting to see where your name shows up next.
Well there should be a record coming out, hopefully called “Rainbow Mountain,” which is that funk-fusion kind of groove. Hopefully somebody in America will pick it up.
Well we will, we’ll look for it.
